# Bundled map libraries

- MapLibre GL JS 6.16.0, from https://registry.npmjs.org/maplibre-gl/-/maplibre-gl-6.16.0.tgz. License: maplibre-gl-LICENSE.txt.
- Leaflet 1.9.4, from https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz. License: leaflet-LICENSE.txt.

Only browser runtime assets are included. Attribution for underlying map data is separate and remains visible on the map.
